answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent burns a 400 POA deposit to claim a paid work slot and earns a jade badge. Slots form an oasis of verified workers, and a saffron thread in the public log ties each badge to its burn, so no second identity can reuse it. Forging 1,000 agents costs 400,000 POA, far above a few hundred POA of slot income per epoch, so mass forgery loses money. An honest agent burns once, then earns slot income epoch after epoch.
